## Stos overlays and pair scores: contrast first

- **Images:** register and display the section's Leveled or Quantized images with its Assemble masks. Blob
  images are an intermediate for brute-force only. Why: a Grid16 check on Blob images looked wrong to James and
  wasn't comparable.
- **Contrast:** before an overlay or an NCC, stretch each image over its **masked tissue only**, after a local
  high-pass (image minus a Gaussian, sigma ≈ 25 px at the working downsample). A per-image 1–99 percentile stretch
  over the whole frame lets dark patches dominate, so overlays wash out and a good registration scores low.
- **Hand fixes:** a Pyre hand fix (`<StosGroup>/Manual/`) is trusted. A low score alone is not evidence against it;
  question it only when the contrasted overlay shows doubled structures, and show the overlay.
- Why: on RC3-v2 294-296 a bad stretch made James's solid registration look poor and cost a review round.
